function spriteOptions(value){const opts=['<option value="">沒有立繪</option>'];characters.forEach(c=>{const url=(c.image||'').trim()||Object.values(c.moods||{}).find(u=>u&&String(u).trim())||'';if(!url)return;opts.push('<option value="'+esc(url)+'"'+(value===url?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(c.name||'未命名')+'</option>');});Object.keys({...BASE_SPR,...(assets.sprite||{})}).forEach(k=>opts.push('<option value="'+esc(k)+'"'+(value===k?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(k)+'</option>'));return opts.join('');}
